description: Implementation of the Auto-fitter module for FreeType, including functions for property management, glyph loading, and module initialization/cleanup.

classes.name: AF_ModuleRec
classes.description: Structure representing the autofit module instance.

classes.name: AF_GlyphHintsRec
classes.description: Structure for glyph hints used during glyph loading.

methods.name: af_property_get_face_globals
methods.description: Retrieves or initializes face global style data.

methods.name: af_property_set
methods.description: Sets module properties such as fallback script, default script, and increase-x-height.

methods.name: af_property_get
methods.description: Gets module properties such as glyph-to-script map, fallback script, default script, and increase-x-height.

methods.name: af_get_interface
methods.description: Returns interface functions for the module.

methods.name: af_autofitter_load_glyph
methods.description: Loads a glyph with hints, used in debugging and normal mode.
